package domain_test

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

const assignedStudent = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
const assignedPath = "dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd"
const assignedItem = "eeeeeeee-eeee-4eee-8eee-eeeeeeeeeeee"
const assignedRevision = "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc"

func frozenContent() domain.AssignedLessonContext {
	content := domain.AssignedLessonContent{Title: "  Ошибки <>&  ", Excerpt: "  Публичное введение  ", Description: "Exact frozen errors.Is(err, target)."}
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal([3]string{content.Title, content.Excerpt, content.Description})
	digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	return domain.AssignedLessonContext{Schema: domain.AssignedLessonContextSchemaVersion, StudentID: assignedStudent, LearningPathID: assignedPath, LearningPathItemID: assignedItem, CourseID: testCourseID, LessonID: testLessonID, LessonRevisionID: assignedRevision, ContentDigest: "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), Content: content}
}
func frozenSource(content domain.AssignedLessonContext, mode domain.LessonMessageMode) *domain.LessonMessageContext {
	value := &domain.LessonMessageContext{Schema: domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersionV2, Mode: mode, CourseID: content.CourseID, LessonID: content.LessonID, ContentRevision: content.LessonRevisionID, LearningPathID: content.LearningPathID, LearningPathItemID: content.LearningPathItemID, ContentDigest: content.ContentDigest}
	if mode == domain.LessonMessageModeSelection {
		value.SelectedText = "errors.Is(err, target)"
	}
	return value
}
func TestT14AssignedContextKeepsRawFrozenStringsAndModeBounds(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []domain.LessonMessageMode{domain.LessonMessageModeOverview, domain.LessonMessageModeSelection} {
		content := frozenContent()
		source := frozenSource(content, mode)
		got, err := domain.VerifyAssignedLessonContext(assignedStudent, testLessonID, source, content)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, source.ContentDigest, got.ContentDigest)
		require.Equal(t, source.ContentRevision, got.ContentRevision)
		require.Equal(t, assignedPath, got.LearningPathID)
		require.Equal(t, assignedItem, got.LearningPathItemID)
		require.Empty(t, got.Language)
		require.Empty(t, got.SectionID)
		if mode == domain.LessonMessageModeOverview {
			require.Equal(t, content.Content.Title, got.Title)
			require.Equal(t, content.Content.Excerpt, got.Excerpt)
			require.Empty(t, got.SelectedText)
		} else {
			require.Equal(t, source.SelectedText, got.SelectedText)
			require.Empty(t, got.Title)
			require.Empty(t, got.Excerpt)
		}
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(got)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.NotContains(t, string(encoded), content.Content.Description)
	}
}
func TestT14AssignedContextFailsClosedForEveryFrozenAnchorAndContent(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"schema", "student", "path", "item", "course", "lesson", "revision", "digest", "changed raw title", "empty content", "title bound", "excerpt bound", "description bound", "invalid UTF8", "foreign selection", "timestamp revision", "uppercase digest", "cross-schema"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			content := frozenContent()
			source := frozenSource(content, domain.LessonMessageModeOverview)
			switch name {
			case "schema":
				content.Schema = "other"
			case "student":
				content.StudentID = testCourseID
			case "path":
				content.LearningPathID = testCourseID
			case "item":
				content.LearningPathItemID = testCourseID
			case "course":
				content.CourseID = assignedItem
			case "lesson":
				content.LessonID = assignedItem
			case "revision":
				content.LessonRevisionID = assignedItem
			case "digest":
				content.ContentDigest = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64)
			case "changed raw title":
				content.Content.Title = strings.TrimSpace(content.Content.Title)
			case "empty content":
				content.Content.Description = ""
			case "title bound":
				content.Content.Title = strings.Repeat("界", 1001)
			case "excerpt bound":
				content.Content.Excerpt = strings.Repeat("界", 4001)
			case "description bound":
				content.Content.Description = strings.Repeat("a", (1<<20)+1)
			case "invalid UTF8":
				content.Content.Description = string([]byte{0xff})
			case "foreign selection":
				source.Mode = domain.LessonMessageModeSelection
				source.SelectedText = "foreign"
			case "timestamp revision":
				source.ContentRevision = testRevision
			case "uppercase digest":
				source.ContentDigest = strings.ToUpper(source.ContentDigest)
			case "cross-schema":
				source.Schema = domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion
			}
			if name == "title bound" || name == "excerpt bound" || name == "description bound" {
				encoded, _ := json.Marshal([3]string{content.Content.Title, content.Content.Excerpt, content.Content.Description})
				digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
				content.ContentDigest = "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
				source.ContentDigest = content.ContentDigest
			}
			_, err := domain.VerifyAssignedLessonContext(assignedStudent, testLessonID, source, content)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext)
		})
	}
}

func TestT14V2ExactWireRejectsPartialCrossSchemaAndOverviewSelection(t *testing.T) {
	data, err := json.Marshal(frozenSource(frozenContent(), domain.LessonMessageModeOverview))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var raw map[string]any
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(data, &raw))
	for _, name := range []string{"schema", "mode", "course_id", "lesson_id", "content_revision", "learning_path_id", "learning_path_item_id", "content_digest", "selected_text", "unknown", "v1", "legacy", "null", "timestamp", "case-alias selection", "case-alias digest"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			fields := map[string]any{}
			for k, v := range raw {
				fields[k] = v
			}
			switch name {
			case "case-alias selection":
				fields["SELECTED_TEXT"] = ""
			case "case-alias digest":
				fields["CONTENT_DIGEST"] = raw["content_digest"]
			case "selected_text":
				fields[name] = ""
			case "unknown":
				fields["private_content"] = ""
			case "v1":
				fields["schema"] = domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion
				fields["content_revision"] = testRevision
			case "legacy":
				delete(fields, "schema")
				delete(fields, "mode")
			case "null":
				fields["learning_path_id"] = nil
			case "timestamp":
				fields["content_revision"] = testRevision
			default:
				delete(fields, name)
			}
			encoded, err := json.Marshal(fields)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			var source domain.LessonMessageContext
			err = json.Unmarshal(encoded, &source)
			if err == nil {
				_, err = domain.NormalizeCurrentLessonMessageContext(&source)
			}
			require.Error(t, err)
		})
	}
}

func TestT14V2RejectsAmbiguousDuplicateFieldsAndNoncanonicalIDs(t *testing.T) {
	source := frozenSource(frozenContent(), domain.LessonMessageModeOverview)
	data, err := json.Marshal(source)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	duplicate := strings.Replace(string(data), `"schema":`, `"schema":"lesson-message-context.v2","schema":`, 1)
	var decoded domain.LessonMessageContext
	require.Error(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(duplicate), &decoded))
	for _, value := range []string{strings.ReplaceAll(assignedPath, "-", ""), "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", strings.ToUpper(assignedPath)} {
		copySource := *source
		copySource.LearningPathID = value
		_, err := domain.NormalizeCurrentLessonMessageContext(&copySource)
		require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext)
	}
}

func TestT14FrozenContentAcceptsExactMaximumBounds(t *testing.T) {
	content := frozenContent()
	content.Content = domain.AssignedLessonContent{Title: strings.Repeat("界", 1000), Excerpt: strings.Repeat("界", 4000), Description: strings.Repeat("a", 1<<20)}
	data, _ := json.Marshal([3]string{content.Content.Title, content.Content.Excerpt, content.Content.Description})
	digest := sha256.Sum256(data)
	content.ContentDigest = "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
	_, err := domain.NormalizeAssignedLessonContext(content, assignedStudent, assignedPath, assignedItem)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	source := frozenSource(content, domain.LessonMessageModeSelection)
	source.SelectedText = strings.Repeat("a", domain.MaximumSelectedLessonTextRunes)
	_, err = domain.VerifyAssignedLessonContext(assignedStudent, testLessonID, source, content)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	source.SelectedText += "a"
	_, err = domain.VerifyAssignedLessonContext(assignedStudent, testLessonID, source, content)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext)
}
